small_M.meaning: completion-critical producer contribution above weight-only fitted stream; scenario, no additional prefetch overlap assumed

large_M_issue_split.meaning: completion-critical producer excess plus complete b1/route/b2 removal; upper scenario, split-only consumer portion unmeasured

limits: CUPTI native kernel timestamps add no device work; profiled vs unprofiled event controls retained
Ceilings are sizing models, not measured counterfactual speedups or G0; no CI can validate a counterfactual assumption
Raw residence includes PDL wait overlapping predecessors (O16F103.8us residence vs6.08us critical), so residence-minus-roof is not an independent saving
Large consumer full-deletion bound is deliberately optimistic; split-only portion measured next
Physical HBM bytes/counters, exclusive native issue waits and physical activation/tensor/epilogue split unmeasured
